reflection.text:
Unblinded truth: docetaxel - ChEMBL Tubulin inhibitor / Tubulin stabiliser (e14,e15 name and BBBC021 structure agree). Verdict correct: submitted Microtubule stabilizers p=0.92 vs truth Microtubule stabilizers.

What got it right - and why:

1. Quantitative tubulin signal was diagnostic and replicated across doses. e2 (0.01 uM rep1, 91 cells) tub_glcm_contrast z=+102.7, tub_mean +41.2, tub_std +36.4; e3 (0.3 uM) +104.0, +38.8; e7 (1 uM) +108.2, +32.4. This is massive increase in intensity/texture/bundling, opposite to a destabilizer which decreases tubulin. e4 microscopist description of bundled perinuclear tubulin matched this, and the taxane stabilization mechanism is well described PMID 36876916 PMID 18068131 PMID 9435925.

2. Comparison to reference atlas separated visual pleiotropy from mechanism. e4 alone listed 4 candidates: Aurora, Microtubule stabilizers, Eg5, Microtubule destabilizers - driven by irregular/large nuclei (e3 nuc_form_factor z=-27.9; e6 nuc_eccentricity +12.2, form_factor -10.9). e5 and e8 corrected this: NSC 2/2 then 3/4 Microtubule stabilizers at similarity 0.90-0.94, k-neighbours 6/10 stabilizers vs Protein degradation 2/10 at 0.85, Cholesterol-lowering 1/10, with no Aurora/Eg5 neighbours. The nuclear dose-response was non-significant (e10 rho=-0.40 p=0.6) and tub_mean rho=+0.20 p=0.8 was flat because absolute level was already saturated high, so they were correctly deprioritized.

3. Acquisition choice was discriminative. e1 showed 8 doses 0.0003-1 uM, 4 wells budget. Instead of replicating one dose, we sampled threshold to saturation: e6 dose 1 (0.001 uM) only tub_mean +9.3 / tub_glcm +6.3 vs e2/e3/e7 extreme >100. This enabled e9 tub_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 p=0 monotonic increase, confirming dose-dependent stabilization rather than a single-well artifact. Budget exhaustion (0/4 left) was acceptable because the same extreme phenotype reproduced in 3 independent high doses each calling stabilizer individually.

What could have misled and did not:
The broad e4 differential and the minor Protein degradation neighbours in e5/e8, plus the strong nuclear shape change at high dose, mimic Aurora/Eg5 pleomorphism. The e11 weak tub_mean dose trend could have been read as destabilizer vs stabilizer ambiguity. Quantitatively, directionality (increase not decrease) and atlas similarity gap (0.92-0.94 vs 0.85) prevented over-weighting those.

Calibration: p=0.92 in e12/e13 appropriately left room for non-specific nuclear effects and atlas impurity while reflecting 3/4 NSC agreement and replicated extreme z-scores. Review approve was justified; no further affordable experiment would overturn direction + atlas evidence. Post-unblinding literature searches e16 (51 hits) e17 (0 hits) were verification only, not used for blind decision.
